Description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot > Reset Token). Required. It is passed only to the bot process and is never written to disk by the template. Revoke it in the Developer Portal if it is ever exposed.

Numeric ID of the ClubÑ server. When set, the slash command appears instantly on that server; when blank it is registered globally (can take up to an hour). Enable Developer Mode in Discord, right-click the server, Copy Server ID.
Name of the slash command members use, lower case, no spaces.
Comma-separated channel IDs where the bot answers. Blank means every channel the bot can see.
Comma-separated role IDs allowed to ask. Blank means everyone.
Optional channel ID where refused questions are reported for moderators. Use a private staff channel.
Also answer messages that @mention the bot. Requires enabling the privileged Message Content Intent in the Developer Portal. The slash command works without it.

Also run the Club Ñ web features in this bot: creator articles, events calendar, Momentazos page, Ahora en directo and /mis_redes. Configure them under the 'Club Ñ Web' settings. Needs the Server Members and Message Content intents and the token of the bot that owns the creator database. Drafts are written by Claude, then DeepSeek, then the local model as a last resort; nothing is published without a moderator's approval.

Extra instructions for how the bot answers, for example what to focus on or how to format answers. Write \n for a new line. It cannot override the fixed rules: answers still come only from cited sources, and the server rules and safety checks still apply.
Placeholder: Prioriza la información del club. Termina con una frase corta animando a participar.

Description: Tone and style of the answers. It changes how the bot writes, never what it claims. Write \n for a new line.
DefaultValue: Cercano, amable y claro, como un miembro veterano de Club Ñ. Tutea a quien pregunta y usa pocos emojis.

Description: Ollama model that writes the answers. Default is Liquid AI LFM2.5-24B-A2B at Q4_K_M: a mixture-of-experts model with about 2B active parameters, so it writes at small-model speed on CPU. Needs about 15 GB of RAM. On a machine with 8 GB use hf.co/LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B-GGUF:Q4_0 instead.

Ollama model for the two rules checks (question and answer). They reply with a single word, so a small fast model is enough (about 1 GB). Set it to the same value as Answer Model to use one model for everything.
How long the models stay in RAM after the last question, for example 5m, 30s or 1h. 0 unloads immediately after every answer.
Context window allocated for the model. 8192 fits the retrieved sources; larger values use more RAM.
Threads used for inference. 0 lets Ollama decide (usually the number of physical cores, the fastest choice on CPU).
Whether the model reasons before answering, if it has a reasoning mode. Off gives much faster answers on CPU; Auto leaves the model's default.
Maximum time for a single model call, including loading the model from disk.
Server rules the bot enforces, in addition to rules.md in the instance folder (editable in AMP's File Manager). Write \n for a new line.
Placeholder: 1. Respeta a todos.\n2. Nada de spam.

Questions waiting while the CPU is busy; beyond this members are told to retry later.
Run a second model check over every answer before it is posted publicly. Catches instructions smuggled in through web pages. Adds a few seconds.
